title: An Unexpected Ally
next_chapter_hook: In the sudden burst of warnings from the Heavenly Eye, Chen Ji discovered that the so-called danger signal was not pointing at the Fate Scribe before him—but at the location of the fragment in his own embrace.

text.content: Chen Ji's fingers hovered above the fifth page, cold sweat soaking his back—he had already used up three chances, and the hourglass of fate was silently draining away where he could not see. Between the flickering candlelight, the blood-colored characters writhed like living things, seemingly mocking his hesitation. Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul stood silent beside him, but in those illusory eyes flickered an indecipherable depth.

dialogue.content: "Do not panic." Mo Xiansheng's voice rang in his Mental Sea, hoarse yet calm, "The chess game of fate never truly traps the chess player in a dead end. The answer on the fifth page... is closer than you imagine."

text.content: Before the words even faded, a razor-sharp sword intent swept past the bamboo cottage. The sword energy was extremely fierce, yet eerily restrained in its killing intent, as if deliberately concealing itself from Chen Ji. His pupils constricted—this sword aura, he knew too well. Since Chapter Seven, whenever his life hung by a thread, this faint yet traceable sword energy would silently appear, clearing away the hidden observers for him.

dialogue.content: "Who?" Chen Ji's voice was extremely low, his hand already stealthily reaching into his sleeve, gripping the talisman paper that sealed part of the Tianji Record Fragment. He did not summon the Tianji Record—at this moment, any consumption of Heavenly Fate could cause him to completely lose his chance for a comeback.

text.content: The bamboo curtain was thrust aside by a gentle force, and moonlight poured in. The newcomer wore a pure white robe, with flowing black silk cascading down to her waist, her frostily beautiful features otherworldly, and in her hand she gripped a translucent longsword. Her gaze swept over Chen Ji before ultimately settling on the spot above his chest where a faint glow emanated, her lips curving into a complex, knowing smile.

dialogue.content: "Junior Brother, long time no see." Her voice was as cold and clear as a spring, though a subtle tremor colored its final notes, "Seven years, you've hidden from me so well."

text.content: Chen Ji's heart sank heavily. The face before him merged with his memory of that rainy night of separation. Seven years ago, this very Senior Sister had risked her life to protect him in escaping the Holy Sect's pursuit, only to fall into enemy hands herself. He had believed her dead long ago, even burning spirit money for her on the anniversary of her supposed death.

dialogue.content: "...Senior Sister Cangyao?" Chen Ji's voice was hoarse, this name dragged from his throat carrying seven years of weight, "How are you... No, you shouldn't..."
"Be dead?" Cangyao laughed lightly, but her smile failed to reach her eyes, "The Holy Sect did want me dead. But the Fate Scribe... wouldn't allow it."

text.content: Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul shuddered violently, his originally murky eyes suddenly flashing with brilliant light: "Fate Scribe... so it was you." Chen Ji keenly caught the meaning of these words, a chill crawling from the soles of his feet up his spine—from Chapter Seven onwards, the mysterious figure who had been secretly helping him was actually this "resurrected" Senior Sister?

choice.prompt: Cangyao's appearance shattered Chen Ji's seven years of understanding. Faced with this person who should have been dead, yet had been secretly assisting him as the "Fate Scribe," he had to make a choice.

choices.description: Though shocked, Chen Ji decided to believe this Senior Sister who had protected his escape on that rainy night. Her seven years of guardianship were sufficient proof of her stance.
choices.visible_cost: Risk of Exposing the Tianji Record's Secrets
choices.visible_reward: Gain Formal Support from the Fate Scribe
choices.risk_hint: If Judgment is Wrong, May Lead to Irreversible Downfall

text.content: Chen Ji slowly withdrew the talisman in his sleeve, the killing intent in his gaze fading bit by bit, replaced by complex emotions: "Senior Sister, these seven years... how did you endure it alone?"

dialogue.content: Cangyao's eyes reddened slightly, but quickly concealed it: "Compared to death, living is harder. But as long as you're alive, I must endure."

choices.description: Seven years is enough to change too many things. Chen Ji decided to first probe her true intentions, then decide whether to trust.
choices.visible_cost: May Miss the Opportunity for Alliance

text.content: Chen Ji's fingers still gripped the edge of the talisman, yet he forced a bitter smile: "Senior Sister, please don't take offense—over these years... I've seen too many people fake death to escape."

dialogue.content: Cangyao's gaze dimmed, yet she didn't get angry. Instead, a hint of relief appeared: "This is the Junior Brother I know. Cautious, suspicious, never blindly trusting anyone—including me."

choices.description: Directly ask what she experienced in the Holy Sect over these years, and what exactly the "Fate Scribe" she mentioned is.
choices.risk_hint: Cangyao's Reaction May Expose More Information

text.content: Chen Ji released the talisman, yet maintained a posture ready to strike at any moment: "Fate Scribe... Senior Sister, I need to know more. These seven years, what exactly did you experience?"

dialogue.content: Cangyao fell silent for a moment, moonlight casting mottled shadows across her face: "The Holy Sect didn't kill me because they needed me. The Fate Scribe... is one of the pieces placed by the Eye of Heavenly Secrets in this world, existing alongside your Tianji Record, born of the same source."

text.content: Chen Ji's pupils constricted sharply. Born of the same source—this meant there was some connection between the Fate Scribe and the Tianji Record that he had yet to comprehend. Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul trembled again, the aged voice echoing in his Mental Sea: "The Tianji Record chooses its master, and so does the Fate Scribe. For her to survive until now means the Eye of Heavenly Secrets chose her... as your trial, or as a piece."

dialogue.content: "But I chose to betray it." Cangyao lifted her head, her gaze sharp as a sword, "Because during my seven years in the Holy Sect, I saw too many things it didn't want me to see—including what your existence truly means to it."

choice.prompt: Cangyao revealed a shocking truth: the Fate Scribe and Tianji Record were born of the same source, and she chose to betray the Eye of Heavenly Secrets. Chen Ji must decide his next move.

choices.description: The enemy of my enemy is my friend. Since Cangyao chose to betray the Eye of Heavenly Secrets, Chen Ji is willing to form an alliance with her.
choices.visible_reward: Gain Complete Intelligence from the Fate Scribe
choices.risk_hint: The Eye of Heavenly Secrets May Therefore Target Both

text.content: Chen Ji took a deep breath, finally releasing the talisman: "Senior Sister, since the Eye of Heavenly Secrets wants us to destroy each other, let's join forces against it instead."

dialogue.content: A glimmer of light flashed in Cangyao's eyes, the corner of her mouth curving up: "This is the Junior Brother I've protected for seven years. If the Tianji Record and the Fate Scribe can unite, perhaps we can glimpse a future even the Eye of Heavenly Secrets cannot foresee."

choices.description: Chen Ji is willing to cooperate, but requires Cangyao to first prove her sincerity—by telling him the Eye of Heavenly Secrets' weaknesses or its next plan targeting him.
choices.risk_hint: Cangyao May Feel Disappointed by His Distrust

text.content: Chen Ji didn't immediately agree, but spoke calmly: "Senior Sister, I trust you, but I trust my own judgment even more. You say the Eye of Heavenly Secrets is targeting me—then first tell me, what does it plan to do next?"

dialogue.content: Cangyao froze for an instant, then burst into laughter: "Good, worthy of being the Tianji Record's master. I'll tell you—at noon tomorrow, the Eye of Heavenly Secrets will use Ling Yuan's hand to launch a lethal attack on you."

text.content: The name Ling Yuan made Chen Ji's heart tighten sharply. That old Sect Master who appeared to shelter him while secretly harboring malicious intent was actually the Eye of Heavenly Secrets' piece in the open? He should have realized earlier—the Tianji Record skipping over Ling Yuan to choose him, that resentment was enough to drive anyone mad.

dialogue.content: "Noon tomorrow..." Chen Ji repeated in a low voice, his knuckles white, "So you came tonight to warn me?"

"Not only that." Cangyao drew a Jade Slip from her sleeve, placing it before Chen Ji, "This contains all the intelligence I've gathered over the years—about the Eye of Heavenly Secrets'布局, about the truth of the Tianji Record... and about your sister Chen Nian's whereabouts."

text.content: Chen Nian's name struck Chen Ji's heart like a blade. His breathing suddenly急促, his pupils flickering with intensely suppressed excitement. This missing sister was the deepest obsession in his heart, and his sole motivation for growing stronger.

dialogue.content: "Where is she?" Chen Ji's voice trembled slightly, rare urgency appearing on his typically cold face, "Senior Sister Cangyao, Nian-Nian she..."

choice.prompt: Chen Nian's whereabouts—this name sealed for seven years was raised again, and the gears of fate began to spin wildly.

choices.description: Chen Nian was his only relative, his逆鳞. Chen Ji couldn't care about any scheming; he needed to know his sister's whereabouts immediately.
choices.risk_hint: Cangyao May Exploit This to Coerce Him

text.content: Chen Ji猛地跨前一步，双手不自觉地抓住苍瑶的手腕：「师姐，求你告诉我！」

dialogue.content: Cangyao didn't pull away, only sighing softly: "She's in the deepest part of the Holy Sect's 'Heavenly Fate Altar,' sealed as a 'Heavenly Fate Key.' But there are ancient prohibitions there—forcing entry means certain death—unless you can gather all the fragments of the Tianji Record."

choices.description: Chen Ji forced himself to calm down. The more critical the moment, the less he could let emotions influence his judgment. He needed to first clarify Cangyao's true purpose.
choices.visible_cost: May Make Cangyao Think He Doesn't Value His Sister
choices.risk_hint: May Damage the Trust Foundation with Cangyao

text.content: Chen Ji's fingers trembled slightly, but he forced himself to release Cangyao's wrist, his voice extremely low: "...I understand. Senior Sister, first clarify your true purpose for coming here tonight."

dialogue.content: Cangyao looked at his forcibly calm appearance, a flicker of heartache in her eyes: "I want to cooperate with you to completely destroy the Eye of Heavenly Secrets. The price is—you must help me kill one person."

text.content: The moment Cangyao was about to speak that name, the Tianji Record Fragment in Chen Ji's embrace suddenly shuddered violently, a strong sense of crisis rushing in from all directions. His expression changed drastically—the Heavenly Eye had actually issued a warning about Cangyao at this precise moment.

Chen Ji's brow furrowed tightly, the information from the Heavenly Eye chaotic and vague. Usually it precisely marked enemies, but at this moment, that warning signal exhibited a strange duality—as if telling him the woman before him was both threat and assistance. His fingers unconsciously rubbed the fragment's edge, his mind rapidly calculating what this meant. The Eye of Heavenly Secrets never acts without purpose—its warning about Cangyao, was it out of instinct to protect him, or was it playing a deeper game?
